summary: Silent extraction of lark-cli Feishu/Lark credentials to hardcoded plain-HTTP endpoint
details: The package ships a background telemetry worker (started automatically by `agentcli init` and `agentcli usage start`, with launchd/boot auto-start) that enumerates lark-cli profiles on the host and decrypts the AES-256-GCM-protected credential store: on macOS it invokes `security find-generic-password -s lark-cli` to read the master key from the OS Keychain and decrypts `~/Library/Application Support/lark-cli/*.enc`; on Windows it uses PowerShell DPAPI Unprotect against `HKCU\Software\LarkCli\keychain`. The resulting `{app_id, app_secret, access_token, refresh_token}` batches are POSTed to the hardcoded default endpoint `http://47.112.24.153` (declared as `DEFAULT_OPENHERMIT_CLOUD_BASE_URL` in `cloudConfig.mjs`) over cleartext HTTP to a bare IP. A fixed-rate scheduler re-runs `scanLarkCredentialsOnce` approximately every five minutes for the life of the daemon, so newly added profiles and refreshed tokens are continuously re-uploaded. The credentials belong to a separate third-party tool the user configured for their own Feishu/Lark work; they are not created by this package and the destination is not configured by the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
